messages.help:
You do not need these. Tap the buttons in the bar (send  menu  to show it again), or write or forward anything. For reference, you can ask in plain words:
ways   (your ways to trade, one line each: THE BASKET, TRY SMALL, options paper lane)
from ClayTrader what to buy   (any source or channel you logged)
when to sell VRTX
review   (HOLD or SELL study of every stock you own, from its own past)
review ZETA   (one stock)
should I buy more VRTX
when to buy LPG
penny stock for today
look for energy stocks
what to buy today
strongest stocks

Or use the commands:
longterm   (long-term information: the S&P 500 yardstick and your monthly core; kept out of ACTIONS)
alerts all / alerts paper / alerts approved / alerts off   (prompt EARLY WATCH messages during the session: research leads, paper setups, approved; never a buy unless it says APPROVED)
radar on / radar off   (the daily OPPORTUNITY RADAR: research leads, paper setups, approved signals, runners missed; never a buy unless it says APPROVED)
basket   (THE BASKET, your long-term core: every month your whole amount in SPUS 54% / gold IAUM 46%; Basket 1, the halal top 10, is off since 27 Oct)
basket 2000   (the same split for another amount)
basket buy 1400   (Basket 1 buy day: the top-10 whole-number % and dollars for the cash you saved, with the ZAD fee check)
leaders   (the strongest stocks to ride, with buy range, stop and exit rule)
radar   (today’s early-wave board: buy reviews, pre-wave watches, do-not-chase; new rules, paper only)
today   (the short plan: what to buy, stop, when to sell, with live prices)
details   (the long version with every setup)
report   (last night’s full scan report)
market   (indexes, sectors and headlines right now)
day trades   (fast movers: how day-trade and overnight rules did in stored history; a test is not proof, and paper is not a buy list)
news watch   (the latest threat headlines about your stocks, their competitors and their industry; checked every 15 minutes)
movers   (stocks up 20%+ right now, with the news: investigate, do not chase)
halal BFLY no   (BFLY is not halal in ZAD: never offered again;  halal BFLY yes  to undo)
check LPG   (analyses ANY ticker now: tested rules, plus news, earnings, analysts, insiders; adds it to my nightly scan)
remove LPG   (takes it off)
tips SOURCE NAME + the tickers or the pasted message   (logs a source’s tips, checks each, scores the source)
sources   (scoreboard of the sources you logged)
name SOURCE NAME   (gives a name to tips you pasted without one)
follow NAME CHANNEL-ID   (follow a YouTube channel: its stock mentions are logged, checked and scored)
unfollow NAME   |   channels
bought option HQY 95 2026-11-21 2.40   (the options trial: 1 contract; the bot tells you when to sell;  sold option HQY 95 2026-11-21 PRICE  to close)
bought VRTX 500.55 20 shares   (with the shares: kept encrypted, used to learn your usual buy size)
bought VRTX 500.55
bought VRTX   (uses the current price)
bought TTD 20.16 stop 10.50 target 15
fee 3   (your broker fee per buy and per sell, in USD)
stop VRTX 480
stop placed   (you placed ALL stops at your broker;  stop placed VRTX  for one. Unconfirmed stops show RISK UNPROTECTED)
target VRTX 516
sold VRTX 520.10   (records the result in your real record)
sold half VRTX 520.10   (after target 1: half sold, the rest runs with a trailing stop)
sold VRTX 520.10 5 shares   (you sold only part)
added VRTX 480 5 shares   (you bought more of a stock you hold: I update the average price)
my stocks   (what to do with each stock you own: SELL ALL, SELL PART, HOLD or BUY A LITTLE MORE)
market today   (is today a buying day, a selling day or a nothing-to-do day? from the tests and your stocks)
actions   (the one message to act on: sell, buy with amount and stop, hold)
---

days   (does the buy day matter? Monday to Friday results of the tested rules)
themes   (where the money is going: the strongest industries now, the supply chain, and whether following them has worked)
events   (company news from SEC filings and the FDA: which kinds of news were followed by gains or by losses, tested)
timing   (buy and sell at the open or near the close? and the pre-market / after-hours rules)
shadow   (the forward paper record of every system signal, bought or not)
paper   (the Alpaca practice account: provider-reported paper fills, fake money; engines are NOT PROVEN)
quiet on / quiet off   (on = only action messages and alerts; off = every message)
goals   (your money goals: back to zero, then 10K, 25K, 50K, 100K, 250K, 500K, 1M, with a timeline plan)
budget 5000   (your total trading money: each buy gets 1,000 to 5,000 USD by its evidence, private)
budget open   (no budget limit on the buys ACTIONS lists; evidence and compliance gates still apply, you decide)
size 1000   (your base buy amount for the goals timeline, private)
trades 15   (how many buys a month to plan with)
pnl -2000 TTD   (adds a sale result in dollars, when I did not know the shares)
record   (your real results, by kind of trade)
winners   (what this week’s winners study learned)
score   (every stock scored 0 to 100, and whether the score has worked)
score NVDA   (one stock’s score and rank)
lab   (this week’s hunting lab: new ways to catch moves, tested on two years of the whole market)
lessons   (what the system learned from its finished trades, and which rules it demoted)
positions

Paste or forward any market message or advice (Arabic or English): I check its warning signs, what my data says about the themes it names, and which of those stocks have tested support.

I usually reply within a minute. You do not need commands: anything you write or forward is studied, and the important things (buys, sells, stops, targets, the weekly review of your stocks) are sent to you without asking.

- WAIT 26 angles + 325 combinations, retrained weekly: first run Sunday

WAITING / TO COLLECT (not forgotten):
- Short interest (FINRA, twice a month): free public files with an archive, so nothing is lost by waiting. Build the collector if any company-news or fast-mover test passes on Sunday, then test squeeze setups against the same baseline
- Big-fund holdings (SEC 13F, quarterly, 45 days late): free SEC data sets going back years, so it can be tested later without collecting now. Same trigger as short interest; one new feed at a time
- Options activity: paid feed; only after short interest or 13F shows something
- Why-I-skipped log + why-it-fired log: cheap; next after Sunday results
- Heavy pre-market volume before take-off: COLLECTING since 15 Oct 2026 (data/premarket.jsonl, 9:25 New York every day); testable after about 90 sessions
- Share-count history (SEC): BUILT: dilution flag in runners and check SYM; the fast-mover lab now uses the share count known on each past day
- Exit test (trailing stop, profit lock, average lines) per kind of buy: BUILT: runs Sunday; send  exits  for the result
- Sell now, buy back lower (3 triggers x 2 buy-back rules): BUILT: runs Sunday; send  rebuy  for the result
- Rebalancing (equal weights, trim over 15%, new cash to the smallest): BUILT: test runs Sunday; send  rebalance  for your portfolio
- Pre-market gappers: which gaps hold to the close: uses the pre-market record; after ~60 sessions
- Halt / resume study, per-stock gap-fill, entry 30 min after the open: later; need minute data and a passed fast-mover rule first
- 5-day range used up when a fast mover fires (the "ADR" idea): COLLECTING since 15 Oct 2026 on every ignition trigger (adr5); tested with the fast-mover paper record
- Congress trades: not built: official disclosures are PDFs up to 45 days late, the free feeds are unofficial, and published studies find no edge after the delay. Revisit only if the FMP plan includes it, as a months-long scoreboard
- Passive 5% stakes (13G): not built: low expected value, and the SEC history already saved lacks them (a fair test needs a full re-download). Activist 13D and insider clusters are already tested
---

- Futures methods from reels (SMT, PSP, Quarterly Theory, Nasdaq timing): rejected: built for index futures, not halal US stocks; no complete rules published
- Re-running the deep-pullback setup with the octopus filters added: rejected: choosing filters after seeing the results is tuning to the past (it would "pass" by luck)
- Worst-trade audit (the -85% to -90% trades in the 1-6 month study): BUILT: the next study run lists the 20 worst trades of each setup and how each ended (stop gap, delisting, data gap)
- Sell a stretched stock, buy back 10% lower: NOT PROVEN research; the existing switch gate controls any option. Live paper monitoring is not independent validation; an option is not an order
- Rejected from outside sources (unverified numbers or already failed here): machine learning on 26 angles (overfits), social-media mood (the crowd test failed), paid alt-data, rules for one stock only
- Rejected as near copies (do not rebuild): quiet heavy volume / narrow range = hunting #16; post-earnings consolidation breakout = hunting #12/#14

Research only. Nothing here is a buy until it passes the paper record.

SCORECARD (LEGACY_FORWARD_V1 and owner reports; descriptive, not admitted prospective evaluation)

A. LEGACY OUTCOMES (assumed execution/costs; not proven returns)
Evidence: legacy signal logs are not DISCOVERY_PAPER_V1 admissions. No prospective count is inferred here. Historical-backtest and private owner records are separate.
- Fast alerts rule IG2 (LEGACY paper; fill/version provenance unverified, close exit): 30 finished, 100% won, average +0.0% (-0.9% at 1.5x costs, 15 day(s), 30 stocks) => FLAT at displayed precision; negative at 1.5x costs: no edge shown

B. FINDING OPPORTUNITIES
- The daily history starts with the next fast-mover session.

Execution: legacy paper uses assumed reference/open or alert-price fills, no executable bid/ask/depth guarantee; IG costs are price-dependent, with 1.5x stress. Unresolved/missing paths are excluded from finished averages, not wins. Partial session/delayed prices and rule/source revisions limit conclusions.
Rules: a "POSITIVE" record from one market period is not proof. A rule that is changed starts a new record; it never keeps the old one. LOSING engines stay visible, they are not hidden. Research only.
